helpGuide.title: How to use the editor
helpGuide.aiBody: The AI assistant helps you build faster: it can choose a template and theme, arrange your photos across sections, and draft text from your description. It doesn't replace you — always review and adjust the result yourself. Like any AI, it can make mistakes, so double-check important details like names, dates, and facts before publishing.
helpGuide.featuresBody: Change the template and color theme, add a background and decorations, upload and rearrange photos — everything saves automatically. Any section can be hidden with the eye icon in the sections list: it disappears from the published site, but its text and photos stay untouched and come back as soon as you show it again.
helpGuide.sectionsBodyPortfolio: A portfolio is built from blocks: a header with navigation, a hero intro, an about section with your photo and achievements, a featured-work gallery, a video block, a contact form, and a footer with social links. Fill in and style what you need, and hide the rest.
helpGuide.sectionsBodyPhotobook: A photobook is built from a cover, an introduction, story sections (text with photos), a gallery, a highlight spread, and an ending. Add photos and text to any section — reorder and restyle them anytime.
helpGuide.linkBodyPortfolio: When you publish, you choose a short name — it becomes part of your site's address: your-name.milestis.site. Pick something easy to say and remember, since it's the link you'll share with clients and on social media. Portfolios are open to search engines.
helpGuide.linkBodyPhotobook: When you publish, you choose a short name — it becomes part of the link: milestis.site/your-name. Only people you send it to will find it — photobooks are hidden from search engines, so pick a name that's easy to share in a message.
